part.Name: Description
part.Short: Though nearly extinct now, for a few short decades the pit beetle was a must-have accessory for any bandit fort or murder cave. Sporting a pair of articulated horns, a determined pit beetle excels at its favorite activity: peeling away armor and feasting on the contents. As violently loyal as =pronouns.subjective= =verb:are:afterpronoun= affectionate, Man Opener is a paragon of =pronouns.possessive= kind. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:wander:afterpronoun= Qud in search of a new keeper, or at least a friend.
